profile.summary: Sindresorhus is a highly experienced JavaScript developer with deep expertise in jQuery's core internals, DOM manipulation, and browser compatibility. Their contributions demonstrate a strong focus on performance optimization (micro-optimizations, minification, JSPerf benchmarking) and frontend tooling (Grunt.js, Bower, EditorConfig). The developer excels at fixing niche but impactful issues across multiple browsers (especially iOS/WebKit quirks) while maintaining clean, optimized code. Their work spans both low-level DOM APIs and higher-level build system integrations, reflecting a comprehensive understanding of the frontend ecosystem.
skill_evidence: PR #1: Fixed `this.text` vs. `val()` for multiple select elements, demonstrating deep DOM property knowledge
PR #4: Addressed iOS-specific event bubbling quirk by setting `documentElement.style.cursor = 'pointer'`, showing browser-specific debugging
PR #6: Fixed WebKit radio input `checked` state loss after cloning, requiring low-level DOM understanding
PR #7: Removed redundant arguments from `slice.call()` and noted 15-byte reduction in `jquery.js`, proving performance-conscious minification
PR #8: Benchmarked `indexOf` vs. regex performance using JSPerf, showing benchmarking expertise
PR #9: Updated `.editorconfig` with new properties and referenced their own Sublime plugin, indicating tooling ecosystem engagement
PR #10: Added `time-grunt` plugin to measure Grunt task execution time, demonstrating build tooling integration
PR #13: Added `keywords` to `bower.json` referencing Google’s Bower best practices, showing package management awareness
